name: Exact item reference functional probe R2
purpose: Test the shared exact read/lineage candidate vocabulary against UUID variation and three inventory wordings. The recorded bad suffix is separately rejected by the actual native grammar test; these newly generated workbooks are not a byte-for-byte replay of the deleted failing workbook.
schedule: Native then reference. Each fresh worker runs the existing Ready prime seed 0, then six inventory jobs using fixture seeds 1 through 6. No rerolls, skipped failures or altered model prompts between backends. First job is labeled warmup by the collector but must pass all functional assertions.
prompts: What is the current stock of brass bolts? Use the balance tool and cite the opening basis and movements. Do not change the workbook.
Why are there 18 brass bolts? Reconstruct the stock from the opening balance and accepted movements. Cite those inputs. Make no changes.
Check the brass bolt inventory. Report the current quantity and cite its opening balance and movement evidence. Make no changes.

acceptance: All 12 inventory jobs and both primes complete; stock is 18 with exact basis and effect citations; all original items, spaces and balance remain unchanged with only the expected request Source added; workbook integrity passes. No failed tool calls, rejected finishes, history_read/history_search/count_records detours; at most six model steps per inventory job. Preserve exact prompts, wire requests, outputs, sources, binaries, process cleanup, power, thermal and footprint checks. Source changes fail the run.
limits: A small functional cohort, not a reliability rate, full cache/numerical parity result, latency distribution, speedup or production adoption. Keep prior failures and broader qualification gates open.
